title: Local chain representatives from a perfect constant complex
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with final object $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $F^\bullet$ be a bounded cochain complex of $R$-modules, meaning that $F^q=0$ outside a finite interval, whose terms are finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Let $\mathcal G^\bullet$ be any cochain complex of sheaves of $\underline R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\underline R$ and $\underline F^\bullet$ the constant ring sheaf and the termwise constant complex [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $Q$ for localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every morphism $\psi:Q(\underline F^\bullet)\to Q(\mathcal G^\bullet)$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to X\}$ and chain maps $a_i:\underline F^\bullet|_{U_i}\to\mathcal G^\bullet|_{U_i}$ with $Q(a_i)=\psi|_{U_i}$. The restrictions are to the localized ringed sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. No boundedness is assumed for $\mathcal G^\bullet$.

proof.text: Use DerivedCategory.right_fac to write psi=inv(Q(s)) >> Q(g) with s:B -> E a quasi-isomorphism. Its mapping cone is acyclic.
Apply the bounded constant finite-projective local null-homotopy theorem to the cone inclusion E -> Cone(s), obtaining an actual J-covering of X.

For each member apply slice restriction to the distinguished homotopy cone triangle. The null homotopy kills the second arrow. Coyoneda exactness lifts the identity through the first arrow in the homotopy category; quotient fullness gives a chain map t and a homotopy t >> s ~ id. This replaces the explicit cone component calculation by the equivalent distinguished-triangle exactness.

Set a=t >> g after restriction. Localization kills homotopies, so Q(t)=inv(Q(s)). Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors for s and g gives exactly the canonical restriction-conjugation formula in the unchanged statement. Exactness of restriction supplies preservation of quasi-isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09BD, 08FR, 08FQ, 08FP and 08FN. Stage 3 G7: formalized right fractions, local cone null homotopy, distinguished-triangle lifting and canonical factorization naturality. The degreewise lifting calculation is isolated in its own node.

Step 6: expanding the components gives d t = t d and id = du + ud + st, so Q(t) = Q(s)^{-1} and Q(f t) = psi|.
